2609.03941.title: Headroom-Drift Replay: A Primitive for Principled Replay Control in GRPO
2609.03941.paper_summary: RL-based post-training for reasoning models is increasingly bottlenecked by repeated fresh rollout generation, particularly in agentic settings where environment interaction dominates wall-clock cost. Replay can reduce this burden by reusing past trajectories, but existing methods typically embed it within larger training pipelines involving exploration, experience restructuring, or mixed-policy optimization. This makes replay's own contribution difficult to isolate. We ask a focused question: how far can principled replay selection alone go? We introduce Headroom-Drift Replay, a group-level replay control primitive for GRPO that separates reuse into two decisions. Headroom ranks stored groups by remaining learning value, while Drift gates them by compatibility with the current policy. The fresh on-policy stream remains unchanged, and the method adds no auxiliary generation or training machinery. Across mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and Agentic Search benchmarks, this single intervention outperforms naive replay and matches or exceeds broader replay methods on Avg Mean@32. In Agentic Search, where environment interaction dominates cost, it delivers comparable quality at materially lower wall-clock time.
2609.03941.paper_summary_zh: 基於強化學習的推理模型後訓練越來越受到重複生成新展開的瓶頸影響，特別是在環境互動主導牆時計成本的代理設置中。重播可以通過重用過去的軌跡來減輕這一負擔，但現有方法通常將其嵌入更大的訓練流程中，涉及探索、經驗重組或混合策略優化。這使得重播自身的貢獻難以孤立。我們提出一個聚焦問題：原則性的重播選擇能走多遠？我們引入了Headroom-Drift重播，這是一種針對GRPO的群體級重播控制原語，將重用分為兩個決策。Headroom根據剩餘學習價值對存儲的群體進行排序，而Drift則根據與當前策略的兼容性對其進行篩選。新的在政策流保持不變，該方法不增加任何輔助生成或訓練機制。在數學推理、多模態推理和代理搜索基準測試中，這一單一干預超越了天真的重播，並在Avg Mean@32上與更廣泛的重播方法相匹配或超過。在代理搜索中，環境互動主導成本，它以顯著較低的牆時計時間提供了可比的質量。
